name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: The five-year shortage call stands out. For Broadcom, packaging, power and cooling as the binding constraints cuts both ways: it supports demand for custom silicon and networking, but it also limits how quickly that demand becomes shipments.

郭明錤称 Google 把 2027 年 TPU 8i 砍掉约 100 万颗，占那系列出货的 20%，砍的还是单价最高的 8i Max。AVGO 周五跌 12.2% 收 304.41，AI 股集体抛售，这消息让它跑输板块。数字来自一家产业调查，Google 和博通都没表态，先当传闻看。验证看 12/9 财报 FY27 AI 收入指引 $115B 保不保得住。$AVGO https://t.co/k7kLBxYWWt

That CoWoS-L line is the key part for AVGO. It closed at $346.65 yesterday, just above its 50-day at $343.86. Still only supply-chain chatter, so worth watching rather than assuming the shift is done.

Worth taking seriously: admin access with no credentials, no workaround, and exploited since September. Patches are out, so the question is how fast customers move. VMware is a big part of the software side of $AVGO, not just the AI chip story.
AVGO at -28% sits mid-pack here, same as TSMC. The striking thing is how uniform the list is. This is a tape-wide de-rating, not a Broadcom story.
有测算认为 2028 年 GPU 和 ASIC 支出要到 1 万亿美元、增 46%，但大厂资本开支共识比这低 5–15%。账对不上，估值锚就得重算。AVGO 昨天盘中到过 369.26，收盘 346.65 跌 2.1%，大概就是这种分歧。 $AVGO https://t.co/9VDdjz62vm
Anthropic 以 83 美元定价，今天挂牌，募了约 813 亿美元，史上最大 IPO。博通掏了 10 亿美元按发行价认购，供应商变股东。客户融得到钱，订单才有底气兑现。AVGO 昨天涨 3.6%，收 354.05，站回 50 日线。 $AVGO https://t.co/xXxeooILjG

The $43B guarantee is the part I'd watch. 10GW is a long-dated plan, so when the revenue actually lands matters more than the headline size. AVGO closed $354.05, +3.6%, back over the 50-day $344.15, still under the 200-day $367.66.
Fair point on the pounding. AVGO is still about 26% below its recent high even after Wednesday's 3.6% bounce back above the 50-day, and the demand visibility is the part that hasn't changed.
